source.description: Production source after the formation, field-goal, badge, wordmark, and balance-audit implementation and before this evidence-only closeout.

operations: Connected to the production preview through CDP Runtime, Page, Emulation, Input, and captureScreenshot methods.
Set 1440x900, 390x844, and 320x568 CSS-pixel viewports at deviceScaleFactor 1.
Navigated the production UI from pregame through coin toss, kickoff, return, next down, and formation selection using rendered controls.
Dispatched keyboard Enter on the focused skip link and inspected activeElement and the computed heading outline.
Changed native select values with bubbling change events, compared before/after board signatures, and activated rendered confirmation buttons.
Added pass-target and tackle-target classes one at a time to the same rendered occupied ball square, measured before/after geometry, then removed each class.
Captured one PNG per viewport through CDP, recorded its encoded size, emptied the in-memory base64 field, and wrote no image file.
driver.disposition: Ephemeral verifier removed after the verification session; it was not production code or a tracked dependency. Its digest, commands, algorithm, assertions, and resulting measurements are recorded here.

assertions.mobile_wordmark_contained: pass: one unwrapped heading line at both mobile widths; 390px and 320px responsive score strips both measured 493.5px high
assertions.literal_heading: pass: Chessball at all three viewports
assertions.heading_contrast: pass: 8.5339:1 against the declared #07110d fallback at all three viewports
assertions.skip_link_heading_focus: pass: keyboard Enter focused #game-workspace with a computed solid 3px outline at all three viewports
assertions.formation_accessible_names: pass: both selects had bound visible labels and bound aria-describedby descriptions
assertions.formation_catalogs: pass: offense and defense each exposed the approved six ordered options
assertions.formation_touch_height: pass: both selects measured exactly 44px high at all three viewports
assertions.formation_colors: pass: both selects computed explicit rgb(249, 231, 182) text on rgb(16, 34, 25) backgrounds
assertions.formation_preview: pass: Trips and Deep Shell updated values, descriptions, and rendered board signatures at all three viewports
assertions.formation_confirmation: pass: offense was directly observed disabled after individual confirmation at 1440px and 320px; defense was directly observed disabled after individual confirmation at 390px; completing the other side removed the formation panel and exposed the command panel at all three viewports
assertions.formation_crowding: pass: descriptions and confirmation buttons did not overlap; measured gap was 7px
assertions.pass_badge: pass: P computed at left 1px and bottom 1px; piece rectangle and 4px inset were identical before/after
assertions.tackle_badge: pass: T computed at left 1px and bottom 1px; piece rectangle and 4px inset were identical before/after
assertions.role_text: pass: rendered role text stayed centered within 1 CSS pixel of the unchanged piece center
assertions.football_marker: pass: computed top/right remained 3px/3px at z-index 3 for both controlled badge states

observations: Native formation controls have visible bound labels, visible bound descriptions, explicit dark-theme colors, touch-action manipulation, and 44px rendered height.
The document retains semantic main content, a skip link, a literal h1, visible focus-visible treatments, and no zoom-disabling viewport directive.

No CSS animation or transition is present, so no reduced-motion override is required; no transition: all, outline suppression, paste blocking, autofocus, image sizing issue, or click-handler navigation anti-pattern was found.
The one-word Chessball heading did not wrap at any tested width; adding text-wrap balancing would not change a single-word heading and was not treated as an implementation defect.

The existing skip-link reveal selector uses :focus so programmatic as well as keyboard focus reveals it; the global :focus-visible rule still supplies the visible 3px ring, directly verified through keyboard activation.

screenshot.disposition: All base64 image data was discarded in memory; no PNG, visual hash, or screenshot asset was written or retained.

execution_notes: The first restricted-sandbox Chromium launch exited 133 with crashpad setsockopt: Operation not permitted; the same recorded Chromium command then ran with the approved host permission required for local browser IPC.
The first restricted-sandbox CDP connection failed with connect EPERM 127.0.0.1:9224; the recorded driver command then ran with the approved host permission required for localhost CDP.
limitations: Rendered verification used one Chromium build and did not cover Firefox, Safari, or other browser/assistive-technology combinations.
The 390px and 320px checks used desktop CDP metrics with the requested innerWidth and deviceScaleFactor 1, not physical mobile-device emulation or physical touch input.
No real screen reader, audible announcement inspection, physical device, or physical board-game session was used.

Pass and tackle overlay geometry was isolated by applying each production target class to the same rendered controlled-ball square; automated application tests separately exercise the real pass/tackle state semantics.
The formation flow was reached through rendered game controls and deterministic UI automation, but the kickoff path varied with the application coin flip and dice results.

Contrast was calculated from the computed gold foreground against the declared #07110d fallback. The decorative translucent gradients and text shadows were not pixel-sampled as separate foreground colors.
Screenshots were inspected only during the run and are not retained, so this artifact is structured measurement evidence rather than pixel-image equality evidence.
